cues: Every codon after it is read in the wrong frame.
Glutamic acid, then leucine, glutamic acid, isoleucine: garbage, all the way to the end.
That is a frameshift, from inserting or deleting bases in any number that is not a multiple of three, and it is far more damaging than a substitution.
